description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wattale, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512000
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and land classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property registration and land title settlement, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
